name: Block Field
description: Provides a field that allows a content entity to create and configure custom block instances.
project_description:
Back to top 

 About this Module 
 The Block Field module provides a field that allows a content entity to reference and configure custom block instances.

 Back to top 

 Use Cases 
 
 Add blocks to a node's sidebar. 
 Add blocks to paragraph. 
 Create a carousel of content and configurable blocks. 
 
 Back to top 

 Demo 
 Evaluate this project online using simplytest.me .

 
 Back to top 

 Installation 
 
 
 Copy/upload the block_field.module to the modules directory of your Drupal installation.

 
 
 Enable the 'Block field' module in 'Extend'. (/admin/modules)

 
 
 Add the 'Block (plugin)' field to any content entity

 
 
 Back to top 

 Notes 
 
 
 The Block field's block instances are stored as configuration, which is good thing, since site builders and editors can easily tweak them with impacting any configuration management.

 
 
 All content blocks from the 'Custom Block Library' are available.

 
 Back to top
